entries.title: Lamentations 3:1
segments: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:2
segments: He hath led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:3
segments: Surely against me he turneth his hand again and again all the day.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:4
segments: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:5
segments: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:6
segments: He hath made me to dwell in dark places, as those that have been long dead.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:7
segments: He hath walled me about, that I cannot go forth; he hath made my chain heavy.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:8
segments: Yea, when I cry, and call for help, he shutteth out my prayer.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:9
segments: He hath walled up my ways with hewn stone; he hath made my paths crooked.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:10
segments: He is unto me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in secret places.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:11
segments: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces; he hath made me desolate.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:12
segments: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:13
segments: He hath caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my reins.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:14
segments: I am become a derision to all my people, and their song all the day.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:15
segments: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath sated me with wormwood.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:16
segments: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones; he hath covered me with ashes.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:17
segments: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace; I forgat prosperity.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:18
segments: And I said, My strength is perished, and mine expectation from Jehovah.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:19
segments: Remember mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:20
segments: My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is bowed down within me.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:21
segments: This I recall to my mind; therefore have I hope.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:22
segments: [It is of] Jehovah's lovingkindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:23
segments: They are new every morning; great is thy faithfulness.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:24
segments: Jehovah is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:25
segments: Jehovah is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:26
segments: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Jehovah.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:27
segments: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:28
segments: Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he hath laid it upon him.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:29
segments: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if so be there may be hope.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:30
segments: Let him give his cheek to him that smiteth him; let him be filled full with reproach.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:31
segments: For the Lord will not cast off for ever.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:32
segments: For though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:33
segments: For he doth not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:34
segments: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,

entries.title: Lamentations 3:35
segments: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the Most High,

entries.title: Lamentations 3:36
segments: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:37
segments: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?

entries.title: Lamentations 3:38
segments: Out of the mouth of the Most High cometh there not evil and good?

entries.title: Lamentations 3:39
segments: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

entries.title: Lamentations 3:40
segments: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to Jehovah.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:41
segments: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:42
segments: We have transgressed and have rebelled; thou hast not pardoned.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:43
segments: Thou hast covered with anger and pursued us; thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:44
segments: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:45
segments: Thou hast made us an off-scouring and refuse in the midst of the peoples.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:46
segments: All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:47
segments: Fear and the pit are come upon us, devastation and destruction.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:48
segments: Mine eye runneth down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:49
segments: Mine eye poureth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,

entries.title: Lamentations 3:50
segments: Till Jehovah look down, and behold from heaven.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:51
segments: Mine eye affecteth my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:52
segments: They have chased me sore like a bird, they that are mine enemies without cause.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:53
segments: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone upon me.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:54
segments: Waters flowed over my head; I said, I am cut off.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:55
segments: I called upon thy name, O Jehovah, out of the lowest dungeon.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:56
segments: Thou heardest my voice; hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:57
segments: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee; thou saidst, Fear not.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:58
segments: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:59
segments: O Jehovah, thou hast seen my wrong; judge thou my cause.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:60
segments: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their devices against me.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:61
segments: Thou hast heard their reproach, O Jehovah, and all their devices against me,

entries.title: Lamentations 3:62
segments: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:63
segments: Behold thou their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their song.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:64
segments: Thou wilt render unto them a recompense, O Jehovah, according to the work of their hands.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:65
segments: Thou wilt give them hardness of heart, thy curse unto them.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:66
segments: Thou wilt pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of Jehovah.
